from scales.bundles import weigh_bundle

# Sort the crates the vans bring in.
BENCHES = ["fine", "heavy"]


def sort_crate(crate):
    crate = weigh_bundle(crate)
    crate["bench"] = BENCHES[0]
    return crate

"""Bundle weighing for the Bywell Steam Laundry."""

TARE_KG = 3


def weigh_bundle(bundle):
    """Return the bundle with its net weight filled in."""
    bundle["net_kg"] = bundle["gross_kg"] - TARE_KG
    return bundle
